name: BubbleMenu-TS-TW
title: BubbleMenu
description: A white pill logo and a round menu button sit at the top of a pale page. Pressing the button blooms five oversized white pill links across the centre in a staggered fan, each with its own hover colour.
use: A playful site wants a bold full-screen navigation instead of a plain bar.
avoid: Information-dense sites: five giant pills fill the screen and hide page content.
a11y: Roles and labels are present, but focus rings are missing and the overlay is a mouse-first experience. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a pale grey canvas a white pill with a small logo sits top left and a round white button with two dark lines sits top right. Opened, five large white pill links with big dark labels fill the centre, each tilted a few degrees.
behaves: Tapping the round button turns its two lines into an X and pops the pill links in one at a time with a slight rotation. Hovering a link tints it with its own colour and scales it up, and tapping the X collapses them.
customise: Logo, items with per-link rotation and hover colours, menu background and content colour, fixed positioning, easing, duration and stagger are props.
weight: light: A dozen nodes and short entrance tweens, idle while the menu is shut.
demo: Logo reads "StashUI"; links read Home, About, Work, Blog and Contact.
issues: Open, the five pills take nearly the whole canvas and leave no page content visible.
polishWhy: Soft shadows, tidy pills and a lively staggered open; the pills float a little loosely.
